title: Bitcoin Fixes This? Paraguay President Resigns After Bank Lockout Hits 60% of Country
summary: Ueno’s collapse trapped millions of Paraguayan depositors and triggered a president’s resignation, reviving Bitcoin’s argument for self-custody.

title: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
summary: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.

title: Zcash Upgrade Could Lock $16 Million in Crypto Forever
summary: Zcash's latest upgrade promises faster transactions, but thousands of coins remain in an aging privacy system that will soon stop accepting withdrawals, potentially leaving their owners empty-handed.

title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin Turns a Profit as Bitcoin Rise Lifts Books
summary: The Hut 8-backed miner reversed a second-quarter loss, driven largely by a $197 million gain on its Bitcoin holdings.

title: Solana Labs’ Leap Launches Mobile App for Trading Tokenized Stocks and Crypto
summary: Leap, built by the team behind Dialect, launched a beta iPhone app for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs, metals, currencies and crypto on Solana, pitching itself to traders looking beyond meme coins.

title: Democrats to Push Broader Crypto Market Structure Bill After Sweeping US Midterms: Report
summary: Analysts said that the Clarity Act's path has become tougher, while advocacy group Stand With Crypto has endorsed 27 winning candidates so far.

title: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Plunge, $428 Million in Crypto Longs Get Wiped Out
summary: Bitcoin plunged nearly 5% as AI stocks sank, Democratic midterm wins raised fresh policy questions, and forced liquidations erased a Wednesday rally that had been fueled partly by short covering.

title: Morning Minute: Democrat Sweep Pumps Crypto as Clarity Act Resurfaces
summary: The Dems are already talking compromise on the Clarity Act and their requests all seem logical - does the bill have new life?

title: Stablecoins Go Mainstream as Samsung Wallet Adds USDC on Solana
summary: Eligible U.S. Galaxy users can now buy, hold, send and receive USDC on Solana directly in Samsung Wallet, without a separate crypto app or private keys to manage.

title: Canadian Man Extradited to US Over Plot to Hijack University Supercomputers for Crypto
summary: Prosecutors say Ryan Roach and a co-defendant targeted U.S. universities with supercomputers, stealing logins and secretly mining crypto.

title: Why Bitcoin's Next Soft Fork Could Feel Like a Practice Run
summary: Matt Corallo explains why patching four legacy bugs is about rebuilding muscle memory, just as much as it’s about Bitcoin maintenance.

title: Coinbase Says 99% of Customer Crypto Is Offline and Out of Hackers’ Reach
summary: Coinbase told customers it wasn’t affected by the $6.4 billion Binance hack and detailed its security controls, including offline storage for over 99% of assets, split private keys and kill switches.

title: Canton Coin Gets SEC Nod as Wall Street Tokenization Heats Up
summary: SEC staff said they view Canton Coin as a digital commodity and won’t recommend enforcement over how it’s minted, a week after DTCC launched a tokenization service that runs partly on the Canton Network.

title: What Is x402? How AI Agents Pay With Crypto
summary: Coinbase's x402 protocol puts the web's long-unused 402 code to work so AI agents and apps can pay for APIs and data in stablecoins like USDC.

title: Bitcoin Rebounds After Democratic Midterm Sweep, But Crypto Faces Tougher Fight in Washington
summary: Bitcoin bounced back after Democrats won control of Congress, but a stalled market structure bill and heavy industry campaign spending reveal crypto’s exposure to shifting US political power.

title: Wall Street’s Plumbing Goes Onchain as Morgan Stanley Tokenizes Securities
summary: Morgan Stanley says it has converted U.S. equities and Treasuries into tokenized form through the newly launched DTCC Tokenization Service, which 20 Wall Street firms have signed up to use.
